title: Westeros at War
description: This is a Modpack for the Mincraft Server Westeros at War using the A Game of Blocks Mod by Trep
body:
### What is this Modpack?

Minecraft Modpack for Westeros at War using A Game of Blocks by Trep.
What is A Game of Blocks: A Game of Blocks is a new Minecraft Mod about the World of Ice and Fire (Game of Thrones). 
It contains a custom map-driven realm, regional identity, castles, troops, quests, and faction progression.

If you like Game of Thrones,Minecraft and being able to create your own Stories, you are exactly right here!

Make Sure to Check out the Mod by Trep!!

[A Game of Blocks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/a-game-of-blocks)



Its still largely in development so make sure to join the Mod Discord or the Server Discord.

[A Game of Blocks Discord](https://discord.gg/cGEtSxKS)

[Westeros at War Discord](https://discord.gg/nmFd6Pg2)


### Disclaimer
This project is inspired by the world of A Song of Ice and Fire and Game of Thrones.

Game of Thrones is a television series produced by HBO, based on the book series A Song of Ice and Fire by George R. R. Martin.

This mod is a non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by HBO or George R. R. Martin.
